ns2:course.label: Dance Anatomy and Kinesiology
ns2:course.description: The study of human and anatomy and kinesiology, specifically as applied to dance. The human musculoskeletal system, movement analysis, and conditioning principles are covered both theoretically and practically. Prerequisite: Restricted to Dance majors and minors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to Dance majors and minors only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Nat Sci & Tech - Life Sciences course.
